floater.title: Where is everything?
floater.string: Open this again from Help > Where is everything? Every key is in Help > Keyboard shortcuts ([KEY:Prestige Shortcuts]).

The buttons along the edges of the screen are your toolbars, with their names beside the icons. Right-click a toolbar to add or remove buttons, or to switch to icons only. Drag in more buttons from Me > Toolbar buttons.
Can't find something? Type a word in the "Search Menus" box at the top right of the screen, such as "weather" or "teleport", and the menu items that match light up.
Preferences ([KEY:Preferences]) holds every setting, with a search box at the top. New pages: Weather, ReShade, Accessibility (bigger text, less motion, high contrast) and Skins > Your colours.
The animation overrider has a small bar like Firestorm's: turn it on or off, pick a set and step through your stands. It is in Comm > AO Control, and on the AO toolbar button.
Press [KEY:Take Snapshot] for camera mode: a full-screen camera with focus, exposure and drive modes. Esc leaves it. Photo Studio ([KEY:Photo Studio]) grades colours and runs ReShade effects.
Press [KEY:Quick Library] to find a texture, object, animation, notecard or landmark by name, without opening your inventory.
Missed a group notice or an offer? Comm > Notification Center keeps your recent notifications, the ones still waiting for an answer, and their history.

With an object selected, hold [KEY:Place on Surface] to see where it would land on what is under the mouse, and let go to place it (also Build > Place on Surface). Build > Options > Snap to Objects lines moved objects up against their neighbours.
